answer: Each identity enters a 20-epoch proof bridge. After commitment, a prism beacon assigns five unrelated tasks; the kth account in one funding cluster must solve 5k tasks, so 100 aliases owe 25,250 verified outputs. A quartz Merkle root binds assignments, timestamps, and results. Validators replay 12% of tasks; a duplicate result or missed deadline burns a 50-POA bond and restarts every linked bridge.
